title: Portable Starter
config.size: config_starter.json is too large (1 MB at most).
config.syntax:
config_starter.json has an error in line %d, character %d.

Common causes:
• a comma after the last entry
• a missing quotation mark
• a single backslash – write \\ or /
config.key: config_starter.json: "%s" is unknown. Only "programme" is allowed.
config.list: config_starter.json: "programme" must be a list in [ ].
config.empty: config_starter.json does not list any program.
config.notfound:
None of these programs is in the starter's folder:

%s

Copy the starter into the program's folder or enter the right EXE in config_starter.json.
program.format: config_starter.json, program %d: the entry must be enclosed in { }.
program.key: config_starter.json, program %d: "%s" is unknown. Allowed are "exe" and "parameter".
program.exe: config_starter.json, program %d: "exe" is missing or empty.
program.notexe: config_starter.json, program %d: "%s" is not an .exe file. The starter only starts .exe files.
program.parameter: config_starter.json, program %d: "parameter" must be a list of texts, e.g. ["--datadir", "profile"].
program.placeholder: config_starter.json, program %d: placeholder "%s" is unknown. Allowed are {ordner} (starter folder) and {daten} (data folder).
